## 6. Function

Implement exactly this behaviour (from the reference program's documentation):

```text
Usage: python3 ip/scripts/update_readme_diagrams.py [--dry-run]
```

Per function:

```text
hierarchy_worth_showing: block_diagram.svg is the generated RTL hierarchy; a single box adds nothing.

diagrams: (caption, svg) of a block's diagrams, most explanatory first.

referenced: Diagrams the README's own text (outside the generated block) already shows or names: images, links and
backticked paths. These are not repeated in the generated section (the text keeps its diagram).

link_cells: Links to a block's diagrams; ones already shown on the page (shown) are marked instead of repeated.

place: Replace the generated block, or insert it before the closing sections (Documentation / License / Design
notes), or append it.
```
